title: 1o0elfe
Nahrawan
hook: After the Arbitration a group parted from Imam Ali. The clash took place at Nahrawan.
scenes.0.text: At Siffin, when the guards were hanged on spears and the battle was stopped, the two sides agreed to arbitration. But a group of **Ali**'s army strongly opposed it. They accused Ali and left him, saying, "The judgment belongs only to Allah". Yet they were among those who most pressured Ali to stop the war. Ali admitted that what he said was true, but said that the word was used for a wrong purpose: "The word is truth, but by it is meant falsehood". These dissidents came to be known as the Outsiders, or Separatists. Ali chose to speak to them verbally rather than with a sword.
scenes.0.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.1.text: The outsiders grew tougher over time and began to draw swords on those who did not think as they did. Finally, they killed **Abdullah b. Habbab** and his pregnant wife. When this news reached **Ali**, the situation changed. Ali turned his army against Damascus to the Nahrawan. Before the war, he spoke to them again and asked them to come back. But no compromise was reached, and war broke out between the two sides. The death toll varies, but there is no exact count. What started with the lances hanging from the coffin, ended up in the blood of an innocent woman and her unborn child in the river, and then it became a war.
scenes.1.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
sunni.0.says: The separation of the outsiders and the conflict of the river are commemorated with the Siffin.
shia.0.says: It is also written in the Syiffin scene in the practice where Ali says "the word is truth, the lie is meant" and then clashes at Nahrawan.
questions.0: Why did the group that was among the most pressing on Ali to stop the war oppose Ali when arbitration was approved?
summary: After the Arbitration the Kharijites separated. They killed Abdullah b. Khabbab and his pregnant wife. Imam Ali turned the army to Nahrawan. The event is read in the wake of Siffin.
notes.0: After the Arbitration a group parted from Imam Ali.
notes.1: There was fighting at Nahrawan. The detail is read in the wake of Siffin.
